lessons: The Implement call to codex failed in 2.5s before any work began: the API returned 400 "The 'gpt-6.1-sol' model is not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account." Nothing in the ticket caused this, so its scope and criteria need no change.

A human must fix the provider setup. Either point the codex route at a model that a ChatGPT-account login supports, or give codex credentials that allow 'gpt-6.1-sol'. Then re-run the ticket unchanged.
Codex also logged 'Model metadata for gpt-6.1-sol not found'. A human should check that this model id is spelled correctly in the provider/model config for codex before requeueing.
